meta.name: agent-management
meta.description: Create, manage, and orchestrate AI agents using the AI Maestro CLI. Use when the user asks to "create agent", "list agents", "delete agent", "hibernate agent", "wake agent", "install plugin", "show agent", "restart agent", or any agent lifecycle management task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行管理AI代理的完整生命周期
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要创建、启停或编排多个AI代理。
copy.tagline_en: Manage the full lifecycle of AI agents from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create, start, stop, or orchestrate multiple AI agents.

howto.what: Claude 能通过 AI Maestro CLI 创建、查看、列举、删除、休眠、唤醒、重命名、导出、导入 AI 代理，并管理代理的插件。
howto.when: 当你要求“创建代理”“列出代理”“删除代理”“休眠代理”等代理生命周期管理任务时触发。

say.text: 创建一个名为 my-agent 的代理
列出所有代理及其状态

say.note: Claude 会保存状态并释放资源。

howto.what_en: Claude can create, view, list, delete, hibernate, wake, rename, export, and import AI agents, and manage their plugins using the AI Maestro CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "create agent", "list agents", "delete agent", "hibernate agent", or any agent lifecycle management task.

say_en.text: List all agents with their status

say_en.note: Claude saves state and frees resources.
